title: Morocco calculator readiness research — Batch 30
executive_summary: Added official HCP historical commodity production and 2025/26 government campaign evidence. Morocco now has its 12 administrative regions represented in the region selector, but remains research-only because regional crop coefficients, net farm-gate prices, current input costs and complete enterprise budgets are not yet available.

sources.use: 2025/26 cereal forecast of 90 million quintals and 3.9 million hectares sown; campaign outlook only.
Preliminary regional cereal yield range 15–57 quintals/ha; not crop- or region-disaggregated.
Regulatory input quality and irrigation-water controls, not prices.
Independent 2026 cereal forecast and food security context; differs in estimate/definition from government campaign forecast.

safeguards: No national cereal production forecast was converted into crop yield per hectare.
No wholesale price or wheat reference purchase target was treated as a net farmer farm-gate price.
No old or sample-specific input costs were represented as current national defaults.
Original 10 active calculator country profiles were not changed.
Morocco remains directory-only and is not active in the calculator.
remaining_work: Acquire crop-by-region area, harvested area and yield tables by crop and season.
Collect dated producer settlement prices by region, grade and unit.
Collect current seed, fertilizer, pesticide, labour, machinery and irrigation invoices/official schedules.
Build representative rainfed and irrigated budgets for priority commodities.
Map validated observations into calculator data and add deterministic tests.
validation_pending: JSON parse and registry invariants to be checked after report commit.
